description: Composite 5×4 figure comparing four Fe–20Mn–9Al–1.5C low-density austenitic steels — 3Cr steel, 2Ni steel, 2Ni3Cr steel and 2Ni5Cr steel — one steel per column. Row 1 (a1–d1): EBSD IPF maps, each with a 20 µm scale bar and a colour key for iron fcc (001/101/111), showing equiaxed fully recrystallised grains with no strong texture. Row 2 (a2–d2): matching EBSD phase maps (20 µm scale bars, legend "FCC" in red) that are uniformly red, i.e. only γ austenite with no second phase. Row 3 (e–h): TEM bright-field images (1 µm scale bars) of clean γ grains with annealing twins, dislocation lines and stacking-fault-like fringes. Row 4 (i–l): TEM dark-field images (20 nm scale bars) taken from {110}LRO or {110}κ reflections, showing fine bright ordered domains/κ-carbides; the coarsest, brightest features are in (j) for the 2Ni steel. Row 5 (m–p): SAED patterns labelled [011]γ//[011]LRO (m, p) and [011]γ//[011]κ (n, o), with indexed γ spots plus faint superlattice spots (100LRO, 011LRO, 100κ, 011κ) marked by red dashed cells and coloured circles. The caption states these SADPs were taken along [001]γ, which disagrees with the [011] zone-axis labels printed on the patterns.

observations.observation: The figure is arranged in four columns labelled 3Cr steel, 2Ni steel, 2Ni3Cr steel and 2Ni5Cr steel, with five rows of panels.
Row 1 (a1–d1) shows EBSD IPF maps with 20 µm scale bars and an inset 'Iron fcc' colour triangle labelled 001, 101, 111.
Row 2 (a2–d2) shows EBSD phase maps with 20 µm scale bars and a red legend box labelled 'FCC'; each map is essentially uniformly red.
Row 3 (e–h) shows TEM bright-field images with 1 µm scale bars, and row 4 (i–l) shows TEM dark-field images with 20 nm scale bars — a 20× difference in scale bar length between the two rows.
In the dark-field row the brightest and coarsest ordered regions appear in panel (j), the 2Ni steel, whereas (i) and (l) (3Cr and 2Ni5Cr) show only very fine, low-contrast bright speckle.
The SAED patterns (m) and (p) are labelled [011]γ//[011]LRO and (n) and (o) are labelled [011]γ//[011]κ, i.e. the zone-axis annotations printed on the patterns are [011], not [001].
The caption states (i, j, k, l) are TEM dark-field images taken from the {110}LRO or {110}κ reflections.
The caption states (m, n, o, p) are selected-area diffraction patterns recorded along the [001]γ zone axis, which contradicts the [011] zone-axis labels printed on those same patterns.
The caption states (a1, b1, c1, d1) are EBSD IPF maps and (a2, b2, c2, d2) are EBSD phase maps.
The citing text states that the TEM bright-field images (e–h) show γ austenite microstructures consistent with the EBSD IPF maps.
The citing text states that for the Cr-rich 3Cr and 2Ni5Cr steels, the dark-field images (i) and (l) reveal nanosized long-range-ordering (LRO) domains homogeneously distributed in the γ matrix.

The citing text states that only very faint superlattice reflections appear at 1/2{0-22}γ or/and 1/2{200}γ positions and no satellite spots around the primary γ spots, indicating LRO domain formation in the online UFCed 3Cr and 2Ni5Cr steels.

The citing text states that for the Ni-rich 2Ni and 2Ni3Cr steels the dark-field images (j) and (k) reveal orthorhombic κ-carbides in the γ matrix, with the 2Ni steel having the largest κ-carbides at an average size of 10 nm, and that their low superlattice intensity indicates a very low volume fraction.
The citing text notes the κ-carbide volume fraction cannot be quantified from the dark-field images because the foil thickness is uncertain.
